item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Today’s high temperatures will range from the upper fifties to the upper sixties, with skies mostly cloudy across the region except for some partly sunny breaks in the Champlain Valley, and a chance of rain developing in some areas by late afternoon. Tonight, expect lows from the mid-forties to the low fifties, with skies staying mostly cloudy and scattered light rain or showers possible, especially toward morning. Overall, rain chances today and tonight range from slight to about fifty percent, with any rainfall expected to be light and generally less than a tenth of an inch.
